Course selection advices 
• The maximum full time load per semester is 30 
credits. 
• A smooth course choice should include courses 
of degrees offered in just one Faculty/College.  
• Annual courses are not eligible for semester -
term stays. 
• Exchange students are not waived to comply 
with specific academic requirements of a course 
when applicable. 
• Specific academic information is to be requested 
at Faculty level. 
• Postgraduate studies are open to exchange 
students if assented in the bilateral agreement  / 
on a reciprocal basis

Enrolment 
Course enrolment  
• Course tuition fees are waived for exchange 
students. 
• Course enrolment cannot be guaranteed before 
arrival as it may be s ubject to the limitation s 
imposed by timetable constraints or unexpected 
course cancellations. 
• Even if courses are lectured in different Faculties 
enrolment is to be done in one Faculty only. 
• Enrolment is to be done after arrival according 
with the dates set in the academic calendar 
and/or with the enrolment guidelines of the 
appropriate Faculty. 
 
Grading system & transcript of records 
Grading system 
UZ uses a 10-point grading scale expressed in 
both quantitative and qualitative terms 
The scheme is as follows: 
“Suspenso”               Grades 0 – 4,9 / FAIL 
“Aprobado”              Grades 5 – 6,9 / PASS 
“Notable”                 Grades 7 – 8,9 / MENTION 
“Sobresaliente”        Grades 9 – 10 / OUTSTANDING 
“Matrícula de Honor”   Special mention for grades  
9 – 10 / HONORS 
Transcript of records 
Issued by the Faculty/College, it is sent to the 
international office of Home University a fortnight 
/ month from the student departure.
